WP-06.closure_statement: Under DRAFT-10 every WP-06 row is either accepted on exact Product evidence (40) or unreachable by spec (2); the 3 'outside WP-06' rows are owned by WP-10/WP-11/WP-12. No WP-06 row is open.

oracle_check.statement: The DRAFT-10 WP-06f re-spool wording ('never writes a chunk that is live on either side at the time of that write and never below a_high_water'; pass 2 may land on chunks pass 1 has just freed) is rule (b) of the #108-corrected oracle; the promote wording keeps rule (a) S = free_next and rule (c) phase 2 at [0, len) after step 4 (confirmed mechanically in #136 Ask 4). The dense-fixture precondition (live B densely fills [a_high_water, floor)) is kept. It is what makes 'pass 1 at or above the live-B floor' spec-forced: without it §9.4 permits pass 1 on any disjoint run at or above a_high_water, so the floor assertion would have to be dropped and the case would reduce to the per-write invariant-10 check (no write to a then-live chunk) that oracle.check_floor_row already makes on every trace. Relaxing it adds no coverage.
